_comment: Template for the download step. Copy to release/downloads-manifest.json and
fill in the published artifacts; that file is local and stays out of Git.
Every field below is required except build, releaseId, perpetualCompatible
and historical. bytes and sha256 are checked against the source file before
anything is written. signature and notarization describe THIS file, and the
script verifies them where the platform tools are available; it fails when a
claim does not hold. Never copy these values from another release.
